title: InvoML v1.0
description: Invoice Markup Language v1.0 — compact invoice format for AI structured output

meta.description: Document metadata — type, number, dates, currency, and tax configuration.

expiryDate.description: Expiry date for quotes and estimates (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

locale.description: BCP 47 locale tag for number/date formatting (e.g. en-US, de-DE). Optional.

reference.description: External reference such as a purchase order number. Optional.

creditNoteReference.description: Invoice number this credit note references. Required when documentType is credit_note.

tax.description: Tax configuration. Either a simple single-rate tax or a full multi-category tax system.

oneOf.description: Simple tax — a single label and rate applied to all items.

label.description: Display name for the tax (e.g. VAT, GST, Sales Tax).

rate.description: Tax rate as a percentage (e.g. 10 for 10%).

inclusive.description: If true, item prices already include this tax.

oneOf.description: Full tax — multiple categories with individual rates and behaviors.

system.description: Name of the tax system (e.g. GST, VAT). For display purposes.

compound.description: If true, all tax categories apply to the full base (not split by line item category).

inclusive.description: If true, item prices already include tax. Tax is backed out during calculation.

categories.description: List of tax categories. At least one must be marked as default.

items.description: A single tax category with its rate and behavior flags.

id.description: Unique identifier for this category. Referenced by items via taxCategory.

label.description: Display name (e.g. Standard Rate, Reduced Rate, Exempt).

default.description: If true, items without an explicit taxCategory use this category.

exempt.description: If true, this category carries a 0% effective tax regardless of rate.

reverseCharge.description: If true, tax is reported but not collected. Buyer self-assesses.

withholding.description: If true, this tax is withheld by the buyer and remitted to the tax authority.

inclusive.description: Reserved. Inclusive tax is set at the top-level tax configuration, not per category.

from.description: The issuer (seller, freelancer, service provider), represented either as free-form Markdown or structured fields.

to.description: The recipient (buyer, client, customer), represented either as free-form Markdown or structured fields.

items.description: Line items on the document. At least one is required.

description.description: Description of the good or service.

unit.description: Unit label (e.g. hours, units, kg). Optional.

discount.description: Line-level discount. Either a shorthand string (e.g. "10%" or "50") or a structured object. Omit this field entirely when no discount applies. Do not set to null.

oneOf.description: Shorthand: "10%" for percentage or "50" for fixed amount.
Structured discount with explicit type and value.

type.description: Whether the discount is a percentage of the line total or a fixed amount.

value.description: The discount value (percentage points or currency amount).

label.description: Display label for this discount. Optional.

taxCategory.description: ID of the tax category this item belongs to. References a category in meta.tax.categories. Omit when using the default tax category. Do not set to null.

amount.description: Computed by the runtime. Line total after line-level discount. Do not set manually.

taxAmount.description: Computed by the runtime. Tax amount for this line. Do not set manually.

discounts.description: Invoice-level discounts applied after the subtotal. Applied in order (cascading — each discount reduces the base for the next).

type.description: Whether the discount is a percentage or a fixed amount.

label.description: Display label (e.g. Early Payment Discount, Loyalty Discount). Optional.

payment.description: Payment instructions. Use content for free-form Markdown or structured fields for specific payment methods.

title.description: Custom title for the payment section.

content.description: Free-form Markdown payment instructions. If provided, structured fields are ignored in rendering.

paymentAdvice.description: Opt-in payment/remittance advice. Financial values are computed by the renderer and cannot be authored.

title.description: Non-empty custom heading for the payment advice block.

content.description: Optional Markdown instructions displayed above the computed advice fields.

sections.description: Custom named sections for additional content (terms, scope of work, etc.). Keys must be alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores.

notes.description: Free-form notes displayed at the bottom of the document.

prepaidAmount.description: Amount already paid or deposited. Deducted from total to compute amountDue. The runtime reads this field; AI models MAY set it.

style.description: Presentation hints for renderers. Controls block ordering, visual arrangement, and appearance. Machine consumers MUST ignore this field.

dateFormat.description: Presentation preset for issue, due, and expiry dates. Source dates remain canonical ISO YYYY-MM-DD values. Defaults to iso.

order.description: Explicit block rendering sequence. Blocks not listed are not rendered. Valid built-ins: header, from, to, items, totals, payment, paymentAdvice, notes. Custom sections use section:{key}.

blocks.description: Finite renderer-neutral presentation tokens keyed by a built-in block or section:{key}. Raw CSS is invalid.

hidden.description: List of elements to hide during rendering. Entries may be bare names or use prefixes: column:{name} (line item columns), block:{name} (layout blocks), meta:{field} (header meta fields), or section:{key} (custom sections). Unknown entries are ignored with a warning.

pageFooter.description: Paged-media page footer intent. show controls visibility; format uses {page} and optional {pages} placeholders.

show.description: Whether to show the page footer. Default true.

format.description: Page footer format string. Must contain {page}; may contain {pages}.

totals.description: Computed totals. Populated by the runtime after calculation. AI models should NOT set these fields.

subtotal.description: Sum of all line item amounts before invoice-level discounts.

discountDetails.description: Breakdown of each invoice-level discount applied.

base.description: Taxable base amount for this category.

inclusive.description: Whether this tax is already included in item prices.

withholding.description: Whether this tax is withheld by the buyer and remitted to the tax authority.

total.description: Grand total: afterDiscounts + taxTotal - withholdingTotal (or afterDiscounts if inclusive).

prepaidAmount.description: Amount already paid. Deducted from total to compute amountDue.

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol for display (e.g. $, EUR, GBP). Set by the runtime.

locale.description: Locale used for number formatting. Set by the runtime.

address.description: Postal address represented as explicit ordered lines. Empty entries preserve intentional blank lines; embedded CR/LF characters are not allowed.

party.description: A party MUST use either free-form content or one or more structured fields, never both.

content.description: Complete free-form party display text with Markdown formatting. Fictional example: '**EXAMPLE LANTERN WORKS**\nSample business location\nExample City'.

taxId.description: Tax identification number (VAT number, EIN, RUC, etc.).

attention.description: Attention line — name of a specific person.
